segments.title: Two hundred tabs, and the sidebar keeps up
segments.body: Two hundred open tabs: click three of them, then ⌘T. Only the rows that change do any work now, so a switch does about a third of the bookkeeping. On 0.2.45 the New Tab row also shrank to its arrow once the list outgrew the window; now it keeps its place at the bottom.

segments.title: Onboarding is three steps
segments.body: Starting fresh. It used to be eight steps and up to 24 screens; now it asks where you're coming from, how it should look and a last few choices, and sets the rest from the browser you picked. From the nightly.6 film. Sped up: 3.7× on the left, 2.2× on the right.

segments.title: Peek is on by default
segments.body: A link that opens a new tab, from an ordinary tab. 0.2.45 opened a tab and took you off the page; now it opens in a Peek over it, as in Arc. Links to other sites from pinned tabs Peek too. Settings you already changed stay as they are.

segments.title: Clicking the address edits it in place
segments.body: Click the address and type. 0.2.45 opened the command bar in the middle of the page; now the field edits in place with the suggestions dropping down from it. ⌘T still opens the bar in the middle.

segments.title: A tab switches when the button goes down
segments.body: Press and hold on a tab. 0.2.45 waited for the button to come back up; now the tab switches the moment it goes down, as in Chrome, Safari and Arc, about a tenth of a second off every switch.

segments.title: ⌘W closes every selected tab
segments.body: Click Lexicon, ⇧-click The Daily Ledger, press ⌘W. 0.2.45 closed one tab; now all three go. In a split, ⌘W closes only the pane you're in.

segments.title: ⌥⌘← and ⌥⌘→ switch profiles
segments.body: Personal and Work in one window. 0.2.45 did nothing; now ⌥⌘→ and ⌥⌘← step through your profiles, as in Dia and Arc.

segments.title: ⌥↩ opens the address in Split View
segments.body: ⌘L, type an address, press ⌥↩. 0.2.45 opened it in place of the page; now it opens beside it in Split View.

segments.title: A "New tab opened" pill
segments.body: ⌘-click a link, which opens it in a background tab. 0.2.45 gave no sign beyond a new row in the sidebar; now a pill in the page's top right takes you to it.

segments.title: Reopening a window you just closed keeps Back
segments.body: Two pages deep in a doc that saves as it unloads. Close the window with ⇧⌘W and bring it straight back with ⇧⌘T. 0.2.45 was still closing it, so the tab came back with no history; now Back works.

segments.title: A loading tab keeps its address, not about:blank
segments.body: A link with target=_blank to a page that answers after 8 s. About 1.5 s in, 0.2.45 turned the tab into about:blank: the row, the address field, and Copy URL (⇧⌘C, pasted into Notes). Now the row shows slow.example/timetable, the address field keeps slow.example and Copy URL copies the real address until the page arrives.

segments.title: A light custom colour keeps the sidebar readable
segments.body: A light grey custom colour on a profile, in dark mode. 0.2.45 kept tab titles, groups and icons white on light grey; now they turn dark, as Arc draws them. Settings › Appearance › "Adjust text to the colour" turns it off.

segments.title: Glass or classic? shows the difference
segments.body: The look step in onboarding, Liquid Glass and then Classic. Before, both drew the same preview; now each shows what it looks like. From the nightly.6 film.

segments.title: Settings search finds what you typed
segments.body: Search Settings for "cli". 0.2.45 listed every setting with "click" in it; now the ardia command comes first, once, and matches are highlighted.

segments.title: Site Controls opens next to its button
segments.body: The sidebar on the right. 0.2.45 opened Site Controls on the far side of the window; now it opens next to its button, as do the zoom, permission and history popovers.

segments.title: Unread counts, calmer
segments.body: A mail app and a chat whose titles carry unread counts, with the setting on (it's now off by default). 0.2.45 put a small red badge on the icon; now a calm pill with larger digits sits at the end of the row.

segments.title: Top Apps show only the icon
segments.body: Three Top Apps, two with unread counts. 0.2.45 put badges over the tiles; now a tile shows only the site's icon, as in Dia. Halfway through, Settings › Tabs › "Show tab status on Top Apps" goes on and the counts come back in the corners.

segments.title: A group's colour shows without hovering
segments.body: A green group, pointer elsewhere, then folded and opened again. 0.2.45 showed the group's colour only while you hovered it; now the box is always there. Neutral groups still show it only on hover, as in Dia.

segments.title: Help fix Ardia? stays out of the way
segments.body: A new tab on an install that hasn't answered the sharing question. 0.2.45 put the card over the top of the page; now it waits in the bottom-left corner, out of the command bar's way.

segments.title: Command bar results match the field
segments.body: ⌘T and type "trip". The results used a smaller size than the field; now they match the text you're typing.
